limitations: Only DOT/JUNO bottom-roster link-card states are covered; other page regions and link contexts are outside this receipt.

The roster li span:last-child selector also styles the persona label span, so visible labels remain desk-muted while the anchor itself receives the hovered/focused persona-ink. This is native cascade behavior, not a camera override.
Light-theme decorative icons retain pale persona accent color; 32 original images record this minor nonblocking observation. No claim that all decorative contrast was changed.
Source stability was checked at capture close; later repository changes require parent-owned delta validation.
